# Logo & Marketplace Branding Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Ship the approved Annotated logo: master SVG, 256×256 marketplace PNG (generated by a committed render script), replacement monochrome activity-bar icon, and the `package.json` marketplace wiring.

**Architecture:** `media/logo.svg` is the source of truth; `scripts/render-logo.mjs` renders it to `media/logo.png` headlessly via Playwright's chromium (existing devDependency — the script self-verifies 256×256 size and corner transparency before writing). `media/icon.svg` is replaced in place, so both view containers pick it up with no manifest change.

**Tech Stack:** SVG, Playwright (`@playwright/test`, already installed), Node ≥20.19 (`export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@25/bin:$PATH"` before any node/npm/npx command), `@vscode/vsce` via npx.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-03-logo-design.md` — SVG markup below is normative, copied from the spec.

**Branch:** work directly on `phase-7` (current branch; already carries the spec commit).

**Note on testing:** these are static assets plus a build script — there is no unit-testable logic, so tasks use command-level verification (script self-checks, header inspection, `vsce` packaging) instead of TDD test files. The repo gate (`check-types` + `test:unit`) still runs in Task 4.

### Task 3: PNG render script + generated marketplace icon

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/render-logo.mjs`
- Modify: `package.json` (scripts section only)
- Create (generated): `media/logo.png`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create `scripts/render-logo.mjs`** with exactly this content (Node built-ins are fine here — the web-extension restriction applies to `src/` only):

```js
// Renders media/logo.svg -> media/logo.png (256x256) using Playwright's chromium.
// Self-verifies output size and corner transparency; exits non-zero on failure.
import { chromium } from '@playwright/test';
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';

const svgUrl = new URL('../media/logo.svg', import.meta.url);
const pngUrl = new URL('../media/logo.png', import.meta.url);

const svg = await readFile(svgUrl, 'utf8');
const browser = await chromium.launch();
try {
  const page = await browser.newPage({
    viewport: { width: 256, height: 256 },
    deviceScaleFactor: 1,
  });
  await page.setContent(
    `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><style>
      html, body { margin: 0; background: transparent; }
      svg { display: block; width: 256px; height: 256px; }
    </style></head><body>${svg}</body></html>`,
  );
  const png = await page.screenshot({ omitBackground: true });

  // Decode the PNG back in the page to assert size + corner alpha.
  const { width, height, cornerAlpha } = await page.evaluate(async (b64) => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.src = `data:image/png;base64,${b64}`;
    await img.decode();
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = img.width;
    canvas.height = img.height;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    return {
      width: img.width,
      height: img.height,
      cornerAlpha: ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 1, 1).data[3],
    };
  }, png.toString('base64'));

  if (width !== 256 || height !== 256) {
    throw new Error(`expected 256x256, got ${width}x${height}`);
  }
  if (cornerAlpha !== 0) {
    throw new Error(`corner pixel not transparent (alpha=${cornerAlpha})`);
  }
  await writeFile(pngUrl, png);
  console.log('media/logo.png written (256x256, transparent corners)');
} finally {
  await browser.close();
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Add the npm script.** In `package.json` `"scripts"`, insert after the `"package"` entry:

```json
    "package": "node esbuild.mjs --production",
    "build:logo": "node scripts/render-logo.mjs",
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Generate the PNG**

Run: `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@25/bin:$PATH" && npm run build:logo`
Expected: `media/logo.png written (256x256, transparent corners)` and exit code 0

- [ ] **Step 4: Independently verify the PNG header dimensions**

Run: `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@25/bin:$PATH" && node -e "const b=require('fs').readFileSync('media/logo.png');console.log(b.readUInt32BE(16)+'x'+b.readUInt32BE(20))"`
Expected: `256x256`

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit (script + generated PNG together)**

```bash

git commit -m "feat(branding): render-logo script generates 256x256 marketplace PNG"
```
